title: Music History
description: Test your knowledge of legendary musicians and iconic songs across the decades.

questions.prompt: Which British band released 'Strawberry Fields Forever' in 1967?
questions.explanation: The Beatles released 'Strawberry Fields Forever' as a double A-side with 'Penny Lane' in February 1967.

questions.prompt: Donovan's 1966 hit 'Sunshine Superman' was written in response to which artist's work?
questions.explanation: Donovan wrote 'Sunshine Superman' as a response to Bob Dylan's 'Mr. Tambourine Man,' showcasing his own psychedelic folk style in the mid-60s.
